title: Warm Saudi-Arabian Nutmeg Tagine
description: A slow-cooked, aromatic dish originating from Saudi Arabia, characterized by crunchy textures and a warm, slightly spicy flavor profile. This recipe is inspired by the traditional cuisine of the region, with the added twist of ground nutmeg for an Ayurvedic twist.

ingredients.name: Ground cumin
ingredients.notes: Freshly toasted in a dry pan

instructions: Heat the ghee in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the crushed red pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground cumin and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for another 5 minutes, or until they start to tenderize.
Add the chopped potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the ground nutmeg and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve over basmati rice.
